description: Correct the missing-lifecycle-script diagnostic so its recovery instruction is installation-aware and names the generation skew, add regression coverage, and document safe recovery for a sandbox whose image-installed CLI predates the .agro generation.
notes: Governed by mifunedev/agro#1080. Base development at f14840b982532e46459cfe7b620958dcb49326de. Operator authorized a bounded fix through a ready-for-review PR; the advisor never merges. Every tracked edit is assigned to a bounded /delegate worker in an isolated worktree; the advisor runs each gate command and owns acceptance. No Herdr message to the supervisor, no /escalate, no Slack bypass.

userStories.title: D1 - Reproduce and document the cause, separating bundle from source
acceptanceCriteria: evidence.md records the installed bundle version (/opt/oh/package.json) and the current source version (.agro/cli/package.json) as measured values
evidence.md shows the hardcoded .oh/scripts literals present in /opt/oh/dist/agro.js and their absence from current source
evidence.md shows current source resolving the control dir through resolveProjectLayout, with file:line citations
No gateway process was started or stopped and no token or credential value appears in any artifact
The remaining current-source defect is stated as the diagnostic's recovery advice, not as an invented path bug

userStories.title: D2 - Installation-aware missing-lifecycle-script diagnostic
acceptanceCriteria: requireLifecycleScript names a recovery route that can succeed for the reader's actual installation kind, reusing the existing classifyInstallation surface rather than duplicating its logic
An image installation is told to refresh the sandbox image on the host, never to run a verb that refuses
A non-image installation is told the verb that actually vendors the control-plane payload
No .oh symlink, no boot-time install or refresh, no ownership change, no change to resolveProjectLayout semantics
Affected surfaces from AGENTS.md are each marked applied or not applicable in evidence.md

userStories.title: D2 - Generation-skew diagnosis in the same error
userStories.description: Name the mismatch when the other generation's control dir is the one on disk.
acceptanceCriteria: When the resolved control dir is absent but the other generation's control dir exists, the error names that mismatch explicitly
When neither control dir exists, the message remains the incomplete-payload diagnosis
Detection reuses controlDirCandidates or resolveProjectLayout from compat.ts rather than hardcoding directory names

userStories.title: D3 - Decisive regression coverage, failing then passing
acceptanceCriteria: A test asserts the image-install recovery route and fails against the pre-change diagnostic
A test asserts the generation-skew message and fails against the pre-change diagnostic
The failing run against the defect and the passing run after the fix are both captured verbatim in evidence.md
Assertions pin short tokens and identifiers, not whole reflowable sentences
The full .agro/cli Vitest suite passes

userStories.title: D6 - Operator recovery documentation and changelog
userStories.description: Docs plus a user-visible CHANGELOG entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Documentation gives safe recovery steps for a sandbox whose image-installed CLI predates the checkout's control-plane generation
The documented steps do not mutate /opt/oh, install packages globally, restart infrastructure, or run a vendoring update against the operator's checkout
The docs state plainly that agro update refuses for image installations and why
CHANGELOG.md carries a user-visible entry under the unreleased section, in the file's existing format
Any warranted mifunedev/agro-web change is either made or recorded as an explicit gap in evidence.md

userStories.title: D4 - Gates run by the advisor with real outputs preserved
userStories.description: Verification owned by the advisor, not by a worker.
acceptanceCriteria: The advisor personally ran the .agro/cli Vitest suite and recorded the real output
The advisor personally ran /eval and recorded the probe-suite result, including any REGRESSION or SKIPPED probes
The advisor personally ran /audit implementation and recorded the verdict
Every gap, skip, and unverified claim is stated in evidence.md rather than omitted
Operator intent preserved is recorded in prd.md and unchanged

userStories.title: D5 - Ready-for-review PR, never merged
acceptanceCriteria: A pull request targets mifunedev/agro base development and links issue #1080
CI is verified green against the PR head SHA specifically, not against a branch name
GitHub reports the PR mergeable, and it is left ready for review and unmerged
If any gate blocks, the PR stays a draft and the exact gate and required decision are reported instead of a readiness claim

userStories.title: Knowledge impact on oh-cli-portable-lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: oh-cli-portable-lifecycle records the corrected lifecycle diagnostic and its installation-aware recovery route, aligned with this PRD's goals and non-goals
The page body stays source-backed per .agro/skills/wiki/references/schema.md section 3
verified_at advances for the page, whose claims were re-read
.agro/knowledge/README.md is regenerated and bash .agro/evals/probes/wiki-readme-index.sh passes
